audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 fits: 49.48% over 2506 games, close skill lane where Talon holds early tempo but Sylas sustains and scales into a heal-CC bruiser.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart reads Skill x5 with Sylas at rows 4 and 6, while content win[] and the packet levelChart both read Talon on all seven rows. The layers disagree on every row.
audit.why: Content whys and packet agree and are kit-grounded (short trades beat 12s Kingslayer, R engage beats the E2 pull); the full layer is the stale side.
audit.corrected: All seven phases[].side moved to Talon with matching whys; ratings normalised.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text names Talon's R as 'Shadow Assassin' — the real name is Shadow Assault (packet suspectNames confirmed against kit). breakdown.cooldowns had no digits; two bullets carried pasted tradeGood/tradeBad bodies.
audit.why: Kit gives real numbers: Sylas E 13s rank 1, W 12s rank 1, R 80s rank 1; Talon R 100s rank 1. Sylas E1 dash + E2 chain pull is the combo hinge; his W heal makes long trades bad; Talon E denies his dashes.
audit.corrected: Name fixed, cooldowns rewritten with numbers, bullets rewritten to their titles.

audit.why: Most punishable cooldown is Abscond/Abduct (13s rank 1); now numbered in breakdown.cooldowns with the Kingslayer 12s trade window.
Anti-heal into Kingslayer sustain already in report[8] — covers the needs-antiheal missing interaction.

edits.before: W the wave and his chest — the return pass is the damage; stand where the boomerang's geometry doubles.
edits.after: You edge Level 1: W-poke out-tempos him before Kingslayer sustain is online — his Q is his only answer.

edits.before: Q-leap trades begin: W-Q-auto procs the bleed at 2 and most mids don't budget for it.
edits.after: W-Q-auto procs the bleed at 2 and bursts faster than his 12s Kingslayer heal recovers.

edits.before: Full kit: the parkour opens — every wall on mid's border is now a gank route or an exit visa.
edits.after: Full kit: his chain E is 13s at rank 1 — punish every step-up while it and Kingslayer are down.

edits.before: Bleed-string the contacts: W both passes, Q the gap, auto the third stack. The lane bleeds rent.
edits.after: All-in on his cooldowns: W both passes, Q, auto — dodge the E2 Abduct pull and he can't trade back.

edits.before: Shadow Assault online — the roam game doubles and the all-in wraps targets in a blade carousel.
edits.after: Shadow Assault engages before his E2 pull lands — his stolen ult is telegraphed; open first and win.

edits.before: First item spike: the full string one-rotations squishies. Shove and parkour — side lanes owe you taxes.
edits.after: First item: Dirk-Hydra plus bleed out-bursts Kingslayer sustain — commit while his chain E is down.

edits.before: Late Talon flanks from coordinates wards don't cover: R in, string the carry, blade-exit through the wall.
edits.after: Two items: don't duel the heal-CC bruiser head-on — parkour the unwarded wall, R the carry, win on tempo.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Assassin's Path for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Abscond/Abduct: 13s at rank 1 — the dash-pull his combo hinges on; step up only while it's down. - Kingslayer: 12s, his heal — short trades beat it. - Hijack: 80s early. Budget your E for escapes and your 100s R for kills.

edits.before: W on the contact, Q the gap, auto for the bleed, walk through the return — three stacks of rent he paid for one trade.
edits.after: An uncrashed wave is a free Abduct window for him and lost plates for you — shove it to tower, then take the wall.

edits.before: Q-leaping into a held CC for style — Talon without the gap-closer is a roamer stuck in traffic.
edits.after: With W and E up he heals and chains through your string — wait out the 12s Kingslayer window.

edits.before: Even at 6 you keep the initiative: Shadow Assassin (R) lets you engage and burst before he can reliably land the E2 pull that his whole kit hinges on. His stolen ult is situational and telegraphed, so open with your R and bleed while his E and W are down. Respect that a landed Abduct flips it, so bait the chain first.
edits.after: Even at 6 you keep the initiative: Shadow Assault (R) lets you engage and burst before he can reliably land the E2 pull that his whole kit hinges on. His stolen ult is situational and telegraphed, so open with your R and bleed while his E and W are down. Respect that a landed Abduct flips it, so bait the chain first.

notes: Content win[] already Talon on all rows (matches packet), so full sides moved alone — no win[] no-ops. Missing-interaction 'enemy-dash-deniable' (Talon E terrain denying Sylas W/E dashes) could not be verified: Talon's E creates a wall-vault, and whether it functionally blocks Sylas's dashes is a derived-flag claim Riot's text does not support — left out rather than asserted. Sylas is male; pronouns correct.
